subject: Request: mid-cycle seat increase and partial-month proration
messages:
From: Lena Hoff <lena@sparkbridge.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: SparkBridge Billing <billing@sparkbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mid-cycle seat increase — proration & VAT questions

Hi Rishi,

We're getting ready to expand the team using Redwood and want to add 8 more seats to our Dedicated pool effective today. Our billing cycle renews on the 1st of each month, so this is technically mid-cycle. Can you confirm how Redwood handles partial-month charges for seat additions (pro-rate formula, rounding) and how VAT will be applied — SparkBridge is registered in the EU and can provide a VAT ID if needed.

Procurement also needs a pro-forma PDF invoice they can attach to the PO, and they asked whether you can issue the one-time pro-rated charge or add the amount to our next monthly invoice. Also: if we later remove seats during the same billing month, are credits issued or only applied to future invoices?

Thanks — can someone in billing/finance walk us through the breakdown?

Best,
Lena Hoff
Head of Infrastructure
SparkBridge Inc.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Hoff <lena@sparkbridge.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, SparkBridge Billing <billing@sparkbridge.io>
Date: Sun, 30 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle seat increase — proration & VAT questions

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and welcome aboard! Quick answers up front, then I'll loop in Monica from Billing for the formal pro-forma.

- Proration: when seats are added mid-cycle we charge pro-rata for the remainder of the billing period. Our formula is (monthly seat rate) * (remaining days / total days in billing cycle). We round to the nearest cent and aggregate across seats.
- Charge timing: we can either issue a one-time pro-rated invoice immediately (PDF + payment link / charge card on file) or include the amount on your next month's invoice — procurement preference is common.
- VAT: if you provide an EU VAT ID and a valid billing address, we can apply reverse-charge treatment where applicable. If reverse-charge does not apply, VAT will be computed on the pro-rated amount using the tax rate for your billing address.
- Credits: we do not issue intra-cycle refunds for seat removals. If seats are removed mid-cycle, the reduction takes effect at the next billing cycle and you see credits or a lower recurring charge then.

Monica — can you prepare a pro-forma showing both options (immediate one-time pro-rated invoice and a line item to be added to Dec 1 invoice) and include VAT calculations for the EU VAT ID? Also include a payment link and the expected charged amount if we charge the card on file.

Lena — please reply with your billing address and VAT ID when you're ready.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Lena — thanks for the details and the PO. I've prepared a pro-forma and an estimated one-time invoice for the pro-rated seats; attaching both as PDFs. Summary:

- Seats added: 8 (effective 2025-11-30)
- Monthly seat rate: EUR 150.00 per seat
- Days remaining in cycle (Nov 30–Dec 1 billing boundary): 2/30 (example, actual day count applied programmatically)
- Pro-rated subtotal (8 seats): EUR 800.00 * (2/30) = EUR 53.33 -> rounded to EUR 53.33
- VAT (France, 20%): EUR 10.67
- Total one-time charge: EUR 64.00

Notes:
- We can issue this as an immediate one-time invoice (charge card on file or payment link) or include the line on your Dec 1 invoice. Per your PO note, we can put PO-9237 on the invoice.
- Per Redwood policy, intra-cycle seat reductions do not generate refunds. If you remove seats later in December the reduction will be reflected starting with the Jan 1 invoice.

Attachments included:
- SB-SparkBridge-proration-20251130.pdf (pro-forma with line-item breakdown)
- pro-forma-invoice-1887.pdf (PDF pro-forma formatted for procurement)

Payment & next steps:
- If you want us to charge the card on file now, reply with authorization: “Please charge card on file for the pro-rated amount.”
- Otherwise we will add the line to your Dec 1 invoice and mark the PO number on the PDF.

Let me know which option you prefer and I'll issue the final invoice.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
